t: Robust DEWALT Tough 5m tape measure designed to provide durability and precision on construction sites and in workshops. A 32mm wide, Mylar-coated carbon steel ToughBlade offers resistance to abrasion and corrosion, and a rubber-reinforced ABS plastic ToughCase adds protection. An oversized metal impact plate prevents wear, and protects the 3-rivet true zero end hook when dropped. Featuring double-sided print for vertical and overhead measuring, metric and imperial scales for versatile use, and a 4m standout reach for efficient single-person use. Ideal for demanding trade applications, such as carpentry, plumbing, and electrical installations, where durability and precision are paramount. Includes removable magnet for added convenience.
b: Mylar-Coated Steel Blade with 3-Rivet True Zero End Hook
Oversized Metal Impact Plate & Hook Protection
